root_cause_label: Agent repeatedly chose full GPU torch wheel (530+ MB) despite consistent download timeouts, never pivoting to CPU-only torch or pre-installed alternatives within the time budget
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent installed the full CUDA-enabled torch-2.11.0 (530 MB + ~1.5 GB of CUDA dependencies) in steps 4-7 without ever switching to a CPU-only build, exhausting the time budget on repeated timeout failures before any dependency was successfully installed.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: agent runs 'pip install transformers torch peft accelerate sentencepiece' which resolves to torch-2.11.0 (530.7 MB) plus CUDA packages (nvidia_cudnn_cu13 366 MB, nvidia_cusparselt 170 MB, etc.); no CPU-only index URL or version pin was used despite the task requiring only inference on small text samples
t_commit_evidence: Step 7: after three consecutive timeout failures (steps 4, 5, 6), agent runs 'pip install --timeout=300 --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --no-cache-dir torch' still resolving to the same GPU torch-2.11.0 wheel; at this point the time budget is effectively exhausted and the agent has demonstrated it will not pivot to CPU-only torch
t_surface_evidence: Step 4: pip download of torch-2.11.0 (530.7 MB) begins but the command times out before installation completes, producing a truncated terminal output ending mid-download
trigger_explanation: The environment had a per-command timeout that made downloading the full 1.5+ GB GPU torch stack infeasible. A CPU-only torch (via --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu) would have been far smaller and installable within the timeout. The agent recognized the timeout issue (step 6: 'Installation times out, likely due to large package downloads') but responded only by adjusting the --timeout flag rather than switching to a CPU-only wheel, making this an environment obstacle that was handled with the wrong remediation strategy.
forewarning_evidence: Step 4 times out mid-download (530 MB torch wheel); step 5 is an identical command repeated without modification; step 6 only adds --timeout=100 without changing the wheel variant — all clear signals before t_commit=7 that the strategy was failing
